app.name: Kontra
library.empty.title: No pieces yet
library.empty.hint: Open a Guitar Pro, MIDI or MusicXML file. Kontra finds the bass track by itself.
mode.song.hint: Runs through, with an evaluation at the end.
mode.wait.hint: Waits before every note until you play it.
mode.workshop.hint: Repeat a section; the tempo follows your hit rate.
summary.title: Evaluation
summary.ready: Run finished. It is saved in your progress.
summary.intonation: {offpitch} out of tune · {cents} cents off on average
tuner.title: Tuner
hint.laptop: The laptop jack is built for microphones, so the bass sounds duller. Kontra still detects it; a Hi-Z interface or USB instrument cable sounds better.
hint.silent: No audio output found. Kontra keeps running without sound.
transport.name: Playback
level.title: Input
level.name: Input level
lane.name: Tab lane
fretboard.name: Fretboard
histogram.name: Timing
tuner.name: Tuner
calibration.title: Measure latency
calibration.hint: After starting, pluck the open A string eight times exactly on the click.
calibration.running: Listen to the clicks and pluck along …
calibration.done: Measured: {ms} ms (spread ±{spread} ms). Subtracted from now on.
calibration.few: Only {matched} of 8 plucks heard. Play louder and measure again.
calibration.unsteady: The plucks were too uneven. Again, calmly on every click.
transpose.title: Transpose
transpose.hint: Notes and backing track move together. Whatever would be too low or high for your bass moves an octave.
backing.title: Backing track
setup.title: Setup
setup.connection.hint: How is the bass connected to the computer?
setup.level.hint: Play a few notes. The plucks should land in the “good” range; the tuner shows whether the string is in tune.
setup.latency.hint: Optional but more precise: Kontra measures how long a note takes from the pluck to the screen.
setup.done.hint: All set. The first exercise is an eight-bar riff in E minor.
hint.bluetooth: Sound goes over Bluetooth. That adds a large, uneven delay; wired headphones give exact timing.
keyboard.name: Keyboard
settings.lowtop.hint: As when looking down at the fretboard; by default the high string is on top as in tablature.
settings.motion.hint: Less motion shows the tab page by page instead of the scrolling lane and turns animations off.
settings.playmarks.hint: When just playing, Kontra shows hits and mistakes quietly or not at all; the summary afterwards stays complete.
error.device.lost: The audio device is gone ({reason}). Plug it back in and press play.
workshop.above: above target: twice in a row speeds up
workshop.below: below target: twice in a row slows down
hint.backing.missing: The backing track {name} is missing. Kontra plays without it; link it again with “Choose audio file …”.
import.io: it cannot be read (is it missing, or are permissions missing?)
import.unknown: the format is unknown or the file is damaged. Kontra reads Guitar Pro 3–8, MIDI and MusicXML.
import.notrack: the chosen track does not exist
import.long: the piece is too long (more than {bars} bars with repeats)
advice.silent: No signal. Is the bass plugged in, its volume knob up, and the right input chosen?
advice.quiet: Too quiet. Turn the bass's volume knob all the way up, then the gain.
advice.loud: A little loud: turn the gain down a bit.
advice.clip: Clipping: turn the gain well down, or detection gets inaccurate.
advice.gain: Gain is the input amplification: the knob on the audio interface, otherwise in the system settings under Audio → Input devices. Aim: plucks in the “good” range.
advice.laptop: Very quiet for a few seconds. Is the bass in the laptop's headphone/microphone jack? Then the laptop setting helps.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.rewind: Back to the start, or to the loop start when a loop is set
keys.view: View: tab lane, tablature, notation, both
keys.pages: Pages: start, library, practice, exercises, fretboard, ear, progress, tuner, settings
notice.more.strings: The piece goes down to {note}, lower than the bass in your profile. Kontra shows it for {strings} strings; you can change the string count in the settings.
hint.quantum: The audio system works in blocks of {frames} samples ({ms} ms). Every response comes noticeably late. Make them smaller, e.g. in a terminal: pw-metadata -n settings 0 clock.force-quantum 256 (until restart); permanently in ~/.config/pipewire/pipewire.conf.d/ with default.clock.quantum = 256.
settings.input.none: Kontra finds no audio input. Is the interface plugged in? Then “System default” stays.
settings.window.hint: How close to the beat a pluck must be. Automatic: normal, loose on a microphone.
settings.cents.hint: How far off a note may be. Automatic: 50 cents fretted, 30 cents fretless.
tuner.alldone: All strings in tune. Off you go!
tuner.wrongstring: That sounds like another string. Pluck the {name} string.
tuner.up.string: {name} string: tune a little higher (tighten the peg).
tuner.down.string: {name} string: tune a little lower (loosen the peg).
progress.title: Progress
progress.empty.title: No runs yet
progress.empty.text: Play a piece, and you will see here how often and how well you practise.
progress.week: This week: {minutes} min on {days} days. Keep going!
progress.week.none: No practice yet this week. Ten minutes are enough to start.
library.sort.title: Title
setlist.title: Setlists
track.label: Track
present.hint: Full screen, only notes and transport, larger staff lines (F5; Esc ends).
mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.hint: Volumes for backing track, metronome, reference tone and drums; applies at once, also while playing.
mixer.monitor.hint: The sound passes through the computer and so arrives a little late. If your interface has direct monitoring, use that and leave this off.
mixer.shaping.hint: Shapes only what you hear; Kontra detects notes from the unchanged signal.
mixer.shaping.compress.hint: Evens out loud and soft notes.
mixer.shaping.warmth.hint: Rounds off loud notes softly, like an amp turned up a little.
mixer.shaping.neutral.title: Reset sound
hint.monitor.rate: Kontra cannot pass your bass through: input and output run at different sample rates. Choose the same device for both or use the interface's direct monitoring.
keys.loopstart: Loop start at the current bar
keys.loopend: Loop end at the current bar
keys.footswitch: Foot switch: any pedal that sends keys works without a driver. Most send Page Down (play/pause) and Page Up (back) – that already fits. Otherwise set it to one of the keys above.
fretboard.shift: From bar {bar}: index finger to fret {position}
summary.hardest.notes: These notes are worth a second look
progress.history: Workshop tempo over the last 30 days
library.tags.add: Add a tag, e.g. band or slap
density.title: Note density
density.hint: Fewer notes to start with: Kontra leaves out the notes in between and suggests more or fewer after a run.
density.more: {percent} % hit – strong! Next run with more notes?
density.fewer: {percent} % hit. Next run with fewer notes? Then the frame sits first.
settings.adaptive.hint: After a run in song mode or the workshop, Kontra suggests more or fewer notes. You decide.
data.title: Your data
data.hint: Settings, library with setlists and progress in one open JSON file – for a backup or a second computer.
data.import.how: How should the backup be loaded?
data.merge.hint: Your settings stay; new pieces, setlists and runs are added.
data.replace.hint: Everything here is replaced by the backup.
data.exported: Saved to {name}: your settings, {pieces} pieces, {setlists} setlists and {runs} runs.
data.merged: Added from {name}: {pieces} new pieces, {setlists} new setlists, {runs} new runs. Your settings stayed.
data.replaced: Loaded from {name}: settings, {pieces} pieces, {setlists} setlists and {runs} runs.
data.error.format: This is not a Kontra backup (or it is damaged). Nothing was changed.
data.error.newer: The backup comes from a newer Kontra (format {version}). Update Kontra and it will work.
report.export.name: Save progress report for {title}
report.saved: Report saved: {name}. It opens in any browser, also offline.
report.error.none: There are no runs for this piece yet.
report.title: Practice report: {title}
report.subtitle: {artist} · made with Kontra on {date}
report.legend: Line with dots: hit rate. Line without dots: tempo. Dashed: 90 % hits. Oldest run on the left.
package.share.name: Share {title} as a Kontra package
package.saved: Package saved: {name}. Score, chosen track and progress are inside, the backing track is not.
package.saved.audio: Package saved: {name}. Score, chosen track, progress and backing track are inside.
package.opened: Package opened: {title}. {runs} runs from the package are now in your progress.
package.error.unknown: This piece is not in your library.
package.error.missing: {name} is gone. Open the piece again or choose the file once more.
unplug.offer: Meanwhile you can use “{name}”. Plug your device back in and Kontra uses it again on its own.
unplug.back: Your input is back. Press play to go on.
about.title: About Kontra
about.text: Kontra is free software under the MIT licence. It uses these building blocks, all under permissive licences; Qt and KDE Frameworks are linked dynamically.
exercise.title: {name} in {key} ({bpm} BPM)
exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.make.hint: Kontra writes an exercise in the key and tempo you want. It goes into your library and counts for your progress like any piece.
exercises.rhythm.hint: Groove before notes: the root in rhythm; the summary shows your timing spread.
exercises.bundled.hint: {count} exercises in {levels} levels, from the first groove to walking bass. Start at the top; slow any of them down in the workshop.
ear.title: Ear training
ear.hint: Kontra plays something, you play it back on your bass. Whatever you play while Kontra still sounds does not count.
ear.echo.prompt.one: Listen and play the note back.
ear.echo.prompt.many: Listen and play the {count} notes back.
ear.interval.prompt: The first note is {note}. Play the second.
ear.chord.prompt: Play the chord's root, high or low, as you like.
ear.silent: No audio output: Kontra cannot play anything. Choose an output in the settings.
quiz.title: Fretboard quiz
quiz.hint: Kontra asks, you play on your bass. Once you found the note, the fretboard shows everywhere it lies.
settings.source.line.hint: Cable from the bass into an audio interface or a USB instrument cable. Sounds best.
settings.source.laptop.hint: Cable into the laptop's headphone/microphone jack. Works, but sounds duller.
settings.source.midi.found: Play bass lines on a MIDI keyboard. Found: {name}.
settings.source.midi.none: Play bass lines on a MIDI keyboard. None is connected right now.
settings.source.midi.hint: Play bass lines on a MIDI keyboard.
settings.source.mic.hint: For double bass and acoustic bass. Room and reverb come along, so Kontra judges more loosely (window ±90 ms, pitch ±50 cents). With headphones the microphone hears only your bass.
settings.tuning.hint: Used by the tuner and for the tab of files without their own tuning (MIDI, MusicXML). With “Custom” you pick every string yourself, the lowest on the left.
settings.reference.hint: The frequency the tuner and scoring work from. Standard is 440 Hz; some bands and recordings tune to 442 or 432 Hz.
settings.colors.hint: Colours of the strings in the lane. Hit, wrong, early and late always show by shape and sign too.
settings.lefthanded.hint: Mirrors the fretboard: the nut is on the right, as you look at your bass.
help.hiz: Hi-Z means high impedance: an input for instruments like the electric bass. Often marked “Inst” or with a guitar on the interface. On a normal line or microphone input the bass sounds thin and quiet.
help.latency: Latency is the delay between your pluck and the moment Kontra hears it. Kontra subtracts it when scoring, so notes on time do not count as late. The easiest way is to measure it: play on the click.
help.band: The workshop keeps your hit rate between {low} and {high} %: above it gets a little faster, below a little slower. So you always practise just at your limit.
backing.align.title: Align the backing track
backing.align.hint: Kontra finds the beats in your recording and puts the bars on them, even when the band speeds up or slows down. If bar 1 is wrong, move it by a beat.
backing.nobeats: Kontra found no clear beats in this recording. You can still use it at a fixed tempo.
backing.aligned: Found: {bpm} BPM · bar 1 at {first} s · {mapped} of {bars} bars follow the recording
backing.notaligned: Not aligned yet: the piece runs at its own tempo.
stems.title: Without bass
stems.hint: Kontra removes the bass once with Demucs and keeps the result. Takes a few minutes per song.
stems.missing: This needs the program Demucs, which is not installed.
stems.install: Install Demucs: in a terminal, “pipx install demucs” and “pipx inject demucs numpy” (or “pip install --user demucs numpy”). On its first run it downloads its model, about 80 MB. Then try again here; no restart needed.
stems.install.title: How to install Demucs
stems.on: The backing track plays without bass.
stems.sandbox: This needs Demucs on the system. As a Flatpak Kontra may not start programs of the system; install Kontra without Flatpak for this.
settings.midi.missing.none: “{name}” is not connected, and no other MIDI device is.
summary.techniques.note: Does not count towards the hit rate.
home.title: Start
home.setup.title: Kontra does not know your bass yet
home.setup.text: Five short steps: bass, connection, level and tuning, latency. Then every note counts right.
home.last.none.text: Open a file in the library (Guitar Pro, MIDI, MusicXML) or start with the next exercise.
home.next.done.text: Every bundled exercise went above 90 %. The generator makes new ones in any key.
home.week.minutes.label: practised
home.week.runs.label: runs
settings.setup.hint: Bass, connection, level, tuning and latency once more, step by step.
view.title: View
progress.week.oneday: This week: {minutes} min on one day. Keep going!
